protocol.selection: minimum frozen full-development bpc over fixed passes
protocol.index: three-bit random-hyperplane index over learned keys/queries; own plus one-bit-neighbor buckets, bounded recent/full-history probes plus recent global entries
protocol.retained_cache: all per-position entries until stream reset; no eviction or receiver compression of KV
protocol.stale_cache: historical keys/values are cached activations, detached across credit chunks
protocol.forward: sparse receiver races plus one historical winner per depth when history exists
protocol.learning: admitted counterfactual values; conserved local surrogate; realized value gradients
protocol.scope: Exploratory matched small-data intervention; not unrestricted semantic retrieval or physical-energy measurement

projected_event_architecture.assumptions: Physical competition replaces explicit exp/rate-noise division/bounded clock simulation; content, scores, gradient teacher, clipping and actual Adam remain charged. Clock circuits, RNG, index/address work and traffic are separate costs, not zero energy.
